name: ailinter
description: Code quality scoring, secret detection, and vulnerability scanning with inline decorations, CodeLens, hover guidance, Quick Fixes, and project health sidebar

commands.title: AILINTER: Replace secret with environment variable
AILINTER: Suppress warning on this line
AILINTER: Find and edit rules file for current file

walkthroughs.title: Getting Started with AILINTER
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to use AILINTER to keep your code clean, secure, and maintainable — right from your editor.

steps.title: 1. Install AILINTER Binary
steps.description:
Make sure the AILINTER binary is installed on your system.

**macOS (Homebrew):**
```bash
brew install ailinter/ailinter/ailinter
```

**Linux/Windows:**
Download the binary from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ailinter/ailinter/releases) and add it to your PATH.

Verify with: `ailinter version`

> 💡 Don't have the binary yet? You can still open files — scan results will appear once `ailinter` is available.

steps.title: 2. Scan Your First File
steps.description:
Open any Go, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java file and **save it** (`Cmd+S` / `Ctrl+S`).

AILINTER scans automatically and shows your quality score in the **status bar** (bottom-left).

> 🔍 Click the status bar score to see a quick summary of the file's health.

media.altText: VS Code editor showing AILINTER status bar icon

steps.title: 3. Understand Your Score
steps.description:
Every file gets a 0–100 quality score with a clear action label:

- 🟢 **80–100: Go Ahead** — Safe for AI modification
- 🟡 **60–79: Proceed with Care** — Small changes only
- 🟠 **40–59: Needs Work** — Significant issues to address
- 🔴 **0–39: Stop & Refactor** — Refactor before modifying

Issues also appear in the **Problems panel** (`View → Problems`), grouped by severity.

steps.title: 4. Fix Issues with Quick Fix
steps.description:
See a wavy underline? Place your cursor on the line and:

1. Click the **lightbulb** (💡) that appears
2. Or press `Cmd+.` (Mac) / `Ctrl+.` (Windows/Linux)
3. Choose an action:
   - **Get Refactoring Strategy** — opens detailed fix guidance
   - **Replace Secret** — converts hardcoded secrets to env vars
   - **Suppress Warning** — adds `ailinter:disable` to skip

Hover over any issue for a full explanation.

media.altText: Quick Fix lightbulb menu showing AILINTER actions

steps.title: 5. Explore the Sidebar
steps.description:
Open the AILINTER sidebar from the Explorer panel:

`View → Explorer` — look for the **AILINTER** section.

It shows:
- 📊 **Overall project health score**
- 📁 **File count and issue statistics**
- 🔥 **Hotspots** — files with the most issues
- 🧠 **Top code smells** across your project

> 💡 Save multiple files to populate the sidebar with your project's full health picture.

media.altText: AILINTER sidebar showing project health overview

ailinter.enable.description: Enable AILINTER scanning on file save

ailinter.scanOnOpen.description: Automatically scan files when they are opened (not just on save)

ailinter.qualityThreshold.description: Minimum quality score (0-100). Files below this show warnings in the Problems panel.

ailinter.showGutterIcons.description: Show gutter icons and inline decorations for code smells

ailinter.showCodeLens.description: Show CodeLens annotations with function-level scores
